profile.headline: Software Engineer | Java, C++, React, AWS | Scalable Full-Stack Architecture & Development
profile.summary:
Innovative Software Engineer dedicated to delivering scalable, user-centric solutions. I specialize in leveraging computer science fundamentals—data structures, algorithms, and system design—to tackle complex business challenges and optimize large-scale systems

• Programming Languages:  Java, C++, TypeScript, Python, Perl, HTML5, SCSS
• Frameworks & Tools:  Spring Boot, React, Redux, Node.js, JUnit, Mockito, GitHub Copilot
• Databases:  PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB
• Cloud/DevOps: AWS, Kubernetes, Argo CD, Helm, GitOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GoCD

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, CardConnect
positions.description:
• Led a scrum team of software engineers in delivering a previously stalled project (a new payment platform) on schedule, earning the highest annual performance rating for technical leadership and execution.
• Architected and developed a microservices-based platform using Spring Boot and React, and established CI/CD pipelines for deployment to Kubernetes using Argo CD and Helm.
• Mentor team members and lead weekly technical knowledge-sharing sessions covering cs fundamentals, system design, and engineering best practices to support team development and career growth.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Nuix "Investigate"
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a full-stack digital forensic application, "Investigate", enabling visualization and analysis of large datasets using Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, React, Redux, Jenkins, and AWS.
• Achieved the Nuix Hackathon Award two years in a row (2023, 2024) for "Flexible Query Builder" and "AI-Driven NQL Search Filter."
• Delivered impactful customer-focused features such as communication graph visualization, semantic search, tag management, email/chat preview, query builder wizard, offline maps, and natural language processing (NLP) capabilities.
• Analyze new features, bug fixes, and compliance issues (a11y, security, etc) working closely with UI/UX and product
• Streamlined CI/CD processes using Jenkins and deployed updates to cloud-based environments on AWS, ensuring security, high availability, and scalability.
• Collaborate with other engineers to review code, process improvement (e.g., SonarQube and WhiteSource application) and adopt better practices or technologies when applicable
• Presented product demo during sprint retro and development roadmaps during PI planning
• Technologies: Java/Spring Boot, React/Redux, JavaScript, Typescript, KeyCloak, PostgreSQL, Keylines GraphAPI, Backbone.js, ES6, HTML5, SASS/CSS, Webpack, JUnit, Mockito, Jest, REST API, Mapbox API

positions.title: Senior Manager, Engineering Xfinity Mobile
positions.description:
• Designed and delivered a telecom billing solution, "Xfinity Mobile" (Comcast's new wireless telecom service launched in 2017), supporting over 7 million users.
• The area of development includes billing/financial, service provisioning, order processing, API gateway, and front-end's web and mobile app/
• Collaborated with cross functional teams to deliver critical updates ahead of tight launch deadlines.

positions.title: Systems Analyst III, Prepaid Division
positions.description:
• Designed and delivered 50+ development projects in T-Mobile's prepaid service platform (web/mobile web, sales portal, customer care, fulfillment, billing, order management, fraud, data warehouse)
• Conducted solutions design, enterprise concept estimation (ECE) sessions with dev teams and vendors to evaluate Impact Assessment and level of effort, and RMM system specification
• Prepaid Network Management Strategy: Designed and implemented Quality of Service (QoS) features to comply with FCC regulations, optimizing network capacity and enhancing customer experience.
• API for Retail Activation: Developed real-time API solutions for Assurance Wireless, enabling efficient account creation and device activation, resulting in annual cost savings of $2.3M.
• Churn Reduction Initiative: Engineered SMS-based re-engagement strategies for inactive Assurance Wireless customers, reducing churn and increasing revenue by $4.5M annually.

positions.title: Software Engineer, SK Telecom America (acquired by T-Mobile)
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a telecom billing solution focusing on mediation/rating modules using C++ and Oracle database in carrier-grade UNIX environment considering system stability, security, high availability, and scalability
• Developed data analysis program in PERL to investigate and recover error data (CDR, IPDR, UDR) for revenue assurance
• Developed OSS monitoring tool (using C & PERL) for NOC operations that helped identify billing errors in early stages and prevented revenue leakage

volunteerExperiences.description:
* Provide guidance and support to software engineers based in Philadelphia. 
* Mentor in career development, technical skill enhancement, and agile practice.
* Assisted full-stack bootcamp students with fundamental computer science and coding development processes
